rationale: Both Sandeep and Abdul Basith work in LLM tooling and ML infrastructure, with overlapping interests in how AI systems run at scale. Sandeep brings production experience from xAI on large-scale systems and inference optimization, while Abdul Basith is actively researching in these domains at Northeastern—a chance for hands-on technical exchange between someone shipping in industry and a researcher exploring the fundamentals.
intro_message: Sandeep, meet Abdul Basith — a student researcher at Northeastern working in ML infrastructure and LLM tooling who'd benefit from your perspective on inference optimization at scale.
